title: Hostile telepaths encountered on Mars

tellings.quote: If you go to Mars telepathically, the first thing you'll encounter is a group of five telepaths who are not exactly welcoming.

plain: Anyone who travels to Mars by telepathy, the mind alone, will first meet a group of five telepaths who are "not exactly welcoming". The researcher Jeffrey Mishlove, who holds a PhD and studies psychic phenomena, says this to Michels without naming where it comes from.
